title: Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Charges Table and Collection Protections
content:
Riverbend plans are interest-free, and no **Patient Payment Plan** tier carries a fee. The table lists, for each tier, the annual percent interest on plan balances, the fee to open a plan, the fee for a late or missed installment, the fee for a returned ACH draft or check, and the penalty for paying a plan off early.

| Tier | Annual interest (percent) | Setup fee (USD) | Late fee (USD) | Returned-payment fee (USD) | Early-payoff penalty (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Protections while a plan is current

| Tier | Encounters in an active plan receive no final notice, placement or credit reporting | Plan balances ever credit-reported |
|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | Yes | No |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | Yes | No |

A hypothetical patient paying a plan off in one lump sum owes the remaining plan balance and nothing more: the early-payoff penalty is 0.00 on every tier, and a late installment draws a late fee of 0.00.
